title: Pato a la Criolla
description: A traditional Peruvian dish made with slow-cooked duck in a rich and flavorful sauce, served with rice and vegetables.

ingredients.name: peruvian
ingredients.amount: 2 tablespoons Peruvian aji amarillo pepper paste

ingredients.name: nutrient
ingredients.amount: 2 cups mixed vegetables (such as carrots, potatoes, and peas)

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the duck and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the mixed vegetables, Peruvian pepper paste, and 1 cup of water to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Add the cooked rice to the pot and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the duck and sauce over the rice, garnished with chopped cilantro.
